def load():

        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import json,os
ws='/home/USER/runs/paper/glm-hpl0-u1-ceiling/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u090/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(ws,exist_ok=True)
prog='''def comps(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); c=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); c.append((y,x))
                    for dy in(-1,0,1):
                        for dx in(-1,0,1):
                            a,b=y+dy,x+dx
                            if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and g[a][b] and (a,b) not in seen:
                                seen.add((a,b)); st.append((a,b))
                out.append(c)
    return out

def transform(g):
    cs=comps(g)
    n9s=[sum(1 for y,x in c if g[y][x]==9) for c in cs]
    m=min(n9s)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for c,n in zip(cs,n9s):
        if n==m:
            for y,x in c: out[y][x]=0
    return out
'''
